SPS Commerce is a leading provider of cloud-based supply chain management solutions, serving a global network of retail trading partners. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are highly valued. Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain!

Position Summary:

The Sr. Marketing Automation & Insights Manager engineers the data, AI, and automation systems that power segmentation, targeting, and GTM efficiency across Marketing. Working under limited supervision, this role designs strategies for key initiatives, advises cross-functional partners, and mentors others to raise the bar for the team.

Key Responsibilities:

- Design scalable data models for GTM activation, anticipating data dependencies and downstream impacts.

- Advise Marketing teams on data-driven targeting strategy.

- Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that expose SPS marketing knowledge, brand

- Design AI solutions for marketing use cases, integrating AI into day-to-day marketing operations.

- Design automation architectures across the GTM stack, anticipating scale, error handling, and performance needs.

- Design data governance and quality frameworks, anticipating data integrity risks across systems.

- Design innovation roadmaps and adoption plans, partnering with stakeholders to prioritize investments.

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

- 5-7 years of relevant experience in marketing automation, marketing analytics, or a related field

- Proficiency in Python, including production-quality code, testing, and building or consuming APIs

- Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, tool and function calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic loops

- Advanced knowledge of marketing automation and analytics, typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience; working knowledge of project management practices

- Experience mentoring, coaching, or advising other team members

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Proven competence with Microsoft Office and standard marketing platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation platforms (MAP), and low-code/automation tools such as Zapier, S

- Experience with data governance and quality frameworks

- Experience deploying and operating services on a modern cloud or application platform (Atlas, Vercel, AWS, or similar), using Git-based workflows and CI/CD  

- Familiarity with building or deploying custom GPTs or predictive models 

- Familiarity with Claude, Claude Code, the Anthropic API, or comparable agentic development frameworks  

Location:

This role is open to remote candidates in the U.S. or Canada, with hybrid options available for candidates near our Minneapolis, Rogers (Arkansas), or Toronto offices.

What We Offer:

At SPS Commerce, we are committed to ensuring that each employee's compensation reflects their unique experiences, performance, and skills in their role. The salary range for this role considers several factors, including education, relevant skills, work history, certifications, location, and more.

The annual salary range for this role is: $84,370 - $130,790 USD or $87,000 - $150,000 CAD. The actual salary offered will be determined based on the factors listed above and may fall anywhere within the range.

SPS Commerce offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' health, well-being, and financial security. Benefits are country-specific and aligned with local laws and market practices.

Commitment to our Employees:

At SPS we power connections that drive the world of commerce forward, and our success depends on making strong decisions, fostering innovation, delivering unparalleled customer solutions, and driving outstanding business performance. We achieve this by creating an environment where every employee feels a true sense of belonging. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, ensuring everyone feels accepted, valued, and empowered to make a meaningful impact.

Job Posting Title:
Admission Operations & Systems Analyst

Job Details and Requirement:

Department: Office of Admission

Supervisor: Asstistant Director of Admission Operations

Last Updated: September 10, 2026

GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Admission Operations & Systems Analyst provides collaborative support and technical expertise to solve complex issues. Serves as a key member of the Enrollment Management Operations team by managing the CRM, validating data, processing application materials, and building reports. The Analyst also serves as a backup to the Asst. Director of Admission Operations, who oversees the data and technology for the office. The Analyst also provides administrative support as needed for the Office of Admission.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

CRM Management – 30%

- Serve as a Power User and independently problem-solve issues in Technolutions’ Slate CRM. Solve complex technical issues to increase operational functionality.

- Monitor business requirements, identify gaps in current functionality and features, suggest enhancements, and assist the Asst. Director of Admission Operations in building innovative new features to increase effectiveness of the CRM (Slate) for operational, recruitment, and marketing purposes.

- Input data into the CRM (Slate) with a high level of accuracy. Proactively and independently validate the accuracy and efficiency of data and integrations.

- Update and maintain prospect, inquiry, and applicant records.

- In collaboration with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations, analyze, map, and import data into and out of the CRM (Slate) on a regular basis, including the Common Application, test scores, transcripts, external vendors, and other offices. Ensures operational integrity of imported and exported data.

- Work closely with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations in maintaining data integrity and quality, including identifying, developing, and deploying new ways to manage data and clean-up needs across the college’s information systems.

- Build, edit, and deploy complex emails and text communications in the CRM (Slate) in collaboration with the Associate Director of Marketing & Communications and the Assistant Director of Admission Operations. This includes creating and using templates, creating and editing conditional logic using Liquid Markup and Content Blocks, building and testing hyperlinks, creating and editing HTML/CSS code, and pulling complex data queries.

- Build, edit, and evaluate the functionality of events, templates, forms, and portals in the CRM (Slate), including conditional logic, design (using HTML/CSS and/or JavaScript), data mapping, and communications.

- In collaboration with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations, manage the user experience, access, and development for internal staff, external office use, and prospective students in technology environments.

- Serve as a resource and internal expert for staff on CRM (Slate) systems. Provide training and maintain related training materials and documentation in collaboration with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations.

- In collaboration with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations, develop in-depth knowledge of the university's recruitment, marketing, and technology landscape. Advise team members on the capabilities and limitations of systems; provide support, training, and share best practices.

- Attend local and out of state conferences as requested, foster continuous learning in both the CRM (Slate) and the higher education landscape, and evaluate new features for integration. (Approximately 1-2 conferences per year.)

Operations & Document Processing – 30%

- Validate documents and credentials received from applicants. Ensure authenticity and accuracy in all documents submitted to evaluate admission and enrollment (approximately 35,000 documents per year).

- Scan, index, and import documents into the CRM (Slate).

- Maintain extensive knowledge of application requirements. Serve as an expert to internal staff, prospective students, families, and school counselors for accepted document types, requirements for admission, and processing workflows and timelines.

- Oversee processing of the admission email account (approximately 8,000 emails a year). Provide support and training to student operations assistants.

- Manage 4 student Operations Assistants, including hiring, onboarding, and ongoing support. Students are expected to maintain accuracy in document processing, student, parent, and counselor communications, data cleanup, and data validation. Provide oversight on their work, regularly check their accuracy, and provide regular training.

- Support the coordination and deployment of shipments of recruitment materials, posters, acceptance packets, promotional merchandise, and other mail/packages as needed.

Reporting and Data Analysis – 30%

- Create, edit, and run complex data queries and reports in Slate, Microsoft Excel, and PowerBI.

- Maintain knowledge of institutional policies surrounding data maintenance, storage, and sharing. Ensure the CRM (Slate) and all related systems operate in compliance with federal and state law.

- Serve as a resource to current and potential students, campus representatives, and the public about data, materials, and processing.

- Work closely with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations to find, extract, analyze, model, project, synthesize, and present enrollment data and trends, with the goal of supporting decision-making regarding Pitzer College’s recruitment, admission, enrollment, and retention strategies.

- Fulfill requests for data and data analysis from various campus departments and external vendors with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

- Research and respond to ad hoc data requests and questions to support strategic decision-making; provide recommendations based on data findings.

- Collaborate with the Asst. Director of Admission Operations to review data and reports before they are published to ensure accuracy.

- Collaborate internally and with other offices in the planning, designing, and evaluation of surveys.

Other Duties – 10%

- Work internally and with ancillary offices to support technology adoption and use; enhance existing practices with improved processes to increase efficiency and effective use of resources.

- Generate and guide day-to-day projects for student operations assistants as needed.

- Assist with large on-campus events (preparation, coordination, staffing the event).

- Assist in maintaining the back office and inventory.

- Answer multi-line telephones and respond to broad questions about Pitzer College and the other Claremont Colleges.

- Provide back-up reception duties for the front desk as needed.

- Perform other related duties as requested.

- undefined

The individual must possess knowledge, skills and ability to be able to successfully perform the essential functions of the position or be able to explain or demonstrate how the essential functions will be performed, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skills and abilities.

- Advanced ability to understand and navigate a complex relational database and create complex data queries.

- Experience collecting, manipulating, verifying, analyzing, and modeling data.

- Technolutions Slate or a similar Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.

Preferred Qualifications: Experience working in higher education or an office of Admissions. Experience working with Technolutions’ CRM. Experience with Microsoft’s PowerBI. Proficiency in HTML/CSS.

title: Business Analytics Consultant Sr (Commercial)
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Business Analytics Consultant Sr within PNC's Performance Management organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA; Cleveland, OH; or Denver, CO.

It is beneficial to have a working knowledge with Power Apps (including Power BI).

It is required to have SQL and Tableau experience for this role to effective build out dashboards for permeance tracking.

The Performance Management team within CLLO provides strategic reporting, analytics, and data solutions that support CLLO, AMG, and Midland Servicing. Their core mission is to deliver automated insights that align with business priorities and drive operational excellence. This includes developing end-to-end process views, risk-mitigating automations, and capacity metrics to optimize productivity. The team also builds data capture solutions using tools like DNA, SharePoint, and other source systems, offering guidance on technology enhancements and minimizing manual tracking. Their work spans strategic metric visibility, business consulting, and proactive support for client-impacting metrics, enabling leaders to make informed decisions and improve performance across teams.

We seek motivated, driven and creative individuals that enjoy working as part of a team in a high energy environment which thrives on innovation and ingenuity. You will work together to create new solutions which will provide our clients with an exceptional customer experience. Valued opinions, supported by collaborative teams, impact the success of the Commercial Lending Operations organization.

This position may be eligible for remote work in select geographic locations, subject to approval by PNC. If approved, work must be conducted from a quiet, secure, and confidential home-based workspace. Occasional in-office participation may be required based on business needs.

PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

- Leverages complex analytical tools to provide business and technical expertise for the analytics process, tools and useful applications across multiple functions or business units to create data driven solutions.
- Consulting to clients on tool and strategy implementation and monitoring, statistical scoring, business intelligence, data quality, and analytical product / solution development.
- Determining the optimal analytic approach and supporting development, implementation and enhancements.
- Conceptualizing, developing and continuously optimizing analytical solutions for business leadership to enable data driven decision making.
- Analyze results and make recommendations for key business partners and senior management or communicate conclusions from complex analytical solutions to a wide range of audiences.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

- Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
- Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills
Analytical Thinking, Business Intelligence (BI), Concept Development, Data-Driven Decision Making, Data Integration, Market Research, Performance Metrics, Qualitative Research, Strategic Planning

Competencies
Analytical Thinking, Business Acumen, Business Analytics, Consulting, Decision Making and Critical Thinking, Effective Communications, Emerging Technologies

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. Certifications are often desired. Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 06/01/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion.

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.

title: Associate, Data Initiatives and Solutions
description:
Who You’ll Work With:

AB CarVal's Data Initiatives and Solutions (DIS) team connects business needs with data and technology capabilities to accelerate the delivery of business solutions. The Associate partners closely with investment professionals, operations teams, Private Alternatives Product, and Private Alternatives Infrastructure (PAI), including Data Analytics, Data Engineering, and Software Engineering. The role is business-facing and focused on translating problems into practical, scalable solutions rather than serving as a project-coordination function.

This position will report to the Director, Data Initiatives and Solutions (DIS) and is located in Minneapolis, MN.

What You’ll Do:

- Partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, objectives, and desired outcomes, and challenge pre-defined solutions to clarify the underlying “what” and “why.”
- Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve efficiency, and recommend solution approaches aligned with the organization’s technology strategy.
- Help stakeholders understand available capabilities before work enters the delivery pipeline.
- Translate business needs into clear requirements and actionable work for technology teams, including user stories, process flows, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
- Validate that proposed solutions address the underlying business problem, reduce ambiguity, and support efficient execution by development teams.
- Support testing strategy and user acceptance testing.
- Perform exploratory analysis to answer business questions and validate requirements using the firm’s data and analytics tools.
- Build simple reports, dashboards, or Sigma prototypes to facilitate stakeholder discussions and help business users get started with self-service.
- Resolve common friction points such as access requests, basic how-to questions, and getting-started support before escalating to a technology team.
- Determine when a request can be addressed through self-service versus when specialized technical expertise is required, and engage PAI for more complex design and implementation work.
- Ensure business requirements are technically feasible and align with the organization’s data architecture.
- Drive initiatives from intake through implementation, monitoring progress, risks, dependencies, outstanding decisions, and delivery quality.
- Follow up proactively to remove roadblocks, maintain momentum, and escalate issues at the appropriate time.
- Coordinate across business and technology teams and provide clear status updates to leadership.
- Partner with Private Alternatives Product and PAI teams to scope and plan work, resource needs, and delivery to business stakeholders.
- Evaluate opportunities to improve work using AI-enabled tools, identify automation opportunities, and support responsible adoption of AI capabilities.
- Independently drive day-to-day execution while keeping the Director informed of active work, emerging issues, and recommendations before finalizing solution direction or strategic decisions.
- Continuously seek more efficient ways of working and strengthen communication between business, data, and technology teams.

What We’re Looking For:

Required

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline.
- 2+ years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, Product Ownership, Project Management, Data Analytics, Consulting, or a related area.
- Ability to translate business needs into requirements, process flows, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
- Working knowledge of data and analytics platforms and the ability to perform exploratory analysis, create simple reports or prototypes, and collaborate effectively with technical teams.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with executives, portfolio managers, operations teams, engineers, and other stakeholders.
- Business curiosity and analytical thinking
- Self-directed approach with the ability to own workstreams independently, make progress in ambiguous situations, and know when to seek guidance or escalate.
- Strong relationship-building skills
- Solution-oriented mindset
- Commitment to continuous learning and comfort adopting new technologies, AI capabilities, and evolving business processes.

Preferred

- Experience supporting Investment Management, Asset Management, Financial Services, or Capital Markets.
- Experience working with Agile teams and tools such as Jira, Jira Product Discovery (JPD), Confluence, and Loom.
- Working knowledge of modern cloud data and analytics platforms such as Snowflake, Sigma Computing, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
- Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar technologies to improve productivity.
- Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to explore data, validate business requirements, answer routine business questions, and collaborate with technical teams; advanced SQL development or database engineering experience is not required.
- Experience with process mapping tools such as Visio, Lucid, or Miro.
- Exposure to data modeling, change management, Lean / Six Sigma, or product management.

Who We Are:

AB CarVal is an established global alternative investment manager and part of AllianceBernstein’s Private Alternatives business. Since 1987, AB CarVal’s team has navigated through ever-changing credit market cycles, investing $155 billion in 5,850 transactions across 82 countries. Today, AB CarVal has approximately $20 billion in assets under management. The firm has a 38-year history, strong track record and an established reputation in asset-based finance with a team of approximately 74 investment professionals in the US, Europe and Asia. A key differentiator is the firm’s robust global network of established relationships with operating platforms and partners.

Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!

In accordance with applicable law, the minimum and maximum base annual salary for this role is as follows:

Base Salary Range: $85,000 to $100,000

Actual base salaries may vary based on factors including but not limited to education, training, experience, past performance, and other job-related factors. Base salary is just one component of total compensation at AB, which may include, depending on eligibility, commissions, year-end incentive compensation, short- and long-term incentives and Department-specific awards. In addition AB provides a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, sick and vacation time off

All are encouraged to apply. AB does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status or any other basis that is prohibited by applicable law. AB’s policies and practices seek to ensure that employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants based solely on job-related criteria.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:

Verily Health is a data platform and technology company purpose-built to power AI-enabled precision health solutions that accelerate research and improve care for individuals and communities. Uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily transforms multimodal health data into insights, models, and actions that make healthcare more personalized, predictive, and precise.

Description

As a Software Engineer at Verily, you will play a pivotal role in developing and enhancing products that are focused on the promise of precision health. Verily's core strategy to advance precision health is by closing the gap between research and care. The Consumer Health Systems team is responsible for developing data integrations, processing and display of multiple types of patient information including messaging, surveys, device and health record data. The team is composed of full-stack developers who focus on delivering warm, personalized experiences for patients/participants and an adaptive, streamlined experience bridging care delivery and clinical research worlds. Be at the forefront of innovation and tackle exciting challenges within a collaborative and dynamic work environment.

-
Work closely with the development team to design, develop, and deliver new full-stack software features across a range of Verily products.

-
Collaborate cross-functionally to identify dependencies, coordinate delivery, communicate design decisions and define requirements.

-
Come up with ideas to technical design problems, compare options, and propose solutions.

-
Develop using industry-standard tools including GitHub, Google Cloud, Go, React, and Terraform to name a few.

Minimum Qualifications

-
BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in software development.

-
5+ years of experience as a software developer in an industry setting.

-
3+ years of experience with React.

-
Expertise in building software and systems on any of: GCP, AWS or Azure (GCP preferred).

Preferred Qualifications

-
Demonstrated experience with Go, TypeScript, and/or SQL.

-
Experience with designing and implementing scalable data processing pipelines with BigQuery or other analytics-oriented databases.

-
Education or exposure to healthcare or life sciences, with emphasis on HL7 FHIR.

-
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively.

description:

title: C2C Forward Fellow, Data Programs
description:
C2C Forward Fellow, Data Programs

100% Remote within California

Travel Requirement: All fellows will need to travel to Sacramento once a month for an in-person team meeting. We are looking to hire two fellows for each track.

The Foundation for California Community Colleges (FoundationCCC) is recruiting experts to join the inaugural C2C Forward Fellows Program to work directly within the Office of Cradle-to-Career in advancing the work of bridging gaps in state-wide data. The Office of Cradle-to-Career Data (C2C) is a neutral source of trusted information that links siloed data across the state to answer questions on what happens to students once they enter and leave our school system and beyond.

C2C Forward is a fiscally sponsored program of the Foundation of California Community Colleges. As C2C Forward Fellows, leaders and experts from across sectors can contribute their knowledge, experience, and innovation to support Cradle-to-Career Data System’s growth and long-term success.

Fellows will gain hands-on experience creating and maintaining a P20W data system while applying their expertise in domains such as TK-12 education, post-secondary education, workforce outcomes, economics, user center design, data visualization, data file preparation, and more. Fellows will be placed at C2C as an integral member of the Data Programs or Data Infrastructure team to advance the work of C2C’s annual workplan, embracing cross-sector collaboration, and gaining insight into underlying governmental structures and partnerships. As a fellow, you will gain a depth of experience and a wealth of knowledge that can be applied at institutions and beyond to advance research that will better serve Californians in the future.

C2C is required by statute to produce data insights such as dashboards, data reports, query builders via CSV files, a research request process via secure data enclave, and query builders. With the aptitude and bandwidth of the fellows, C2C will be able to produce more useful and necessary tools at a more rapid speed while enhancing the data system infrastructure with up-to-date best practices and most current privacy and security features.

In addition to the projects assigned to fellows, fellows will engage in a work culture that values equity, collaboration, transparency, accountability, and curiosity. C2C staff and leadership take pride in implementing values in the day-to-day work and expanding the team with individuals who also share these same values. Fellows will be empowered to take initiative and responsibility for their work in a safe, fun, and intellectually stimulating environment.

Track I: Data Programs

- The Data Programs team (DPS) is responsible for planning, creating, iterating, and releasing data tools for a wide audience that includes but is not limited to students, families, educators, researchers, advocates, legislators, and policy makers. Fellows on data programs will develop dashboards, query builder tools, and analytical data reports to inform research, advocacy efforts, and policy analysis.

- In collaboration with the engagement team, DPS frequently engages in community conversations to raise awareness of data tools, increase data literacy by discussing data insights with the public, and gathering feedback from the public to iterate designs. The DPS team also works alongside the data infrastructure team to adopt modern cloud-based data practices. Transform your knowledge, expertise, and hands-on experience into practical guidance and toolkits.

Applicant Profile:

- Extensive knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies.

- Knowledge of workforce and higher education admissions, policies, and legislation.

- Direct experience or knowledge of current challenges in data systems, college applications, and transfer processes.

title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About the Team

The Enterprise Intelligence Platform (EIP) builds and operates the AI platform that powers Sony Pictures Entertainment and drives AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) adoption across the studio; it allows application teams to ship faster by using AI in the build process. EIP partners with IT and with business groups to deliver production AI applications and to compress the build cycle through AI-DLC practice. The Forward Deployed Engineer sits inside EIP and is how both the platform and the practice reach the work.

About the Role

This Principal Forward Deployed Engineer role is a newly created role, and this person will help define its future from day one. As one of the first to step into this function, this person will play a pivotal role in building the team, shaping the work that the team delivers, and establishing new ways of partnering with the business to bring AI into production. This person will be deeply embedded with teams across Sony Pictures and help pioneer the AI-DLC that will underpin our next generation of solutions.

This Principal Forward Deployed Engineer is a full-stack senior engineer who partners with other parts of IT and with SPE business teams to ship full applications end to end. The role uses the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), which is AI-assisted development tooling and practice, to compress the build cycle dramatically. Each engagement runs from scoping through prototype, production hardening, and handoff to the incumbent application team that owns the application long-term. Reusable patterns from every engagement flow back into the EIP platform so successive projects compound.

This person will report directly to the SVP of Enterprise Intelligence Platform. This is a write, ship, and own role: production code, AI-DLC practice, and platform feedback. It is not a consulting or solution-architect role. Some of the applications you ship will include LLM inference at runtime (RAG, agents, prompt-based interactions). Production-LLM capability is part of the kit, but the dominant value of the role is shipping the application faster than traditional development cycles allow.

Responsibilities:

- Embed with IT and business teams on priority SPE projects and ship full applications end to end (data layer, backend services, AI integration where the application needs it, user-facing surface), using AI-DLC to compress the development cycle dramatically.
- Lead AI-DLC adoption in your partner teams: coach the team into team-tier self-sufficiency on AI-assisted development so they continue using the practice after you roll off.
- When the application requires inference at runtime, build production LLM components on the EIP platform (RAG, agentic orchestration, prompt architecture, evaluation frameworks, observability, and guardrails).
- Work directly with non-technical business stakeholders, from frontline operators and analysts through senior executives, to draw out what they actually need, shape a solution together, and translate it into a decomposed, shippable plan in real time.
- Harvest reusable patterns from every engagement back into the EIP platform backlog so what you build becomes platform capability and successive engagements compound.
- Hold the line with senior stakeholders when the request needs to change, and own what you ship through the handoff to the incumbent application team.

Qualifications:

- Full-stack production engineering experience across the whole application stack: object-oriented development proficiency, backend services, data pipelines, user-facing application surfaces (web UIs, internal tools, integrations), cloud (AWS and / or Azure), containers, and infrastructure-as-code. You ship every layer, not just the AI components.
- Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or equivalent) to ship production code at meaningfully faster cycle times than traditional development. Comfort generating, reviewing, and iterating on AI-generated code at velocity, with the judgment to know what to keep and what to throw away.
- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
- Some production experience with LLM-based systems (RAG, agents, prompt architecture, evaluation frameworks), applicable to the subset of engagements where the application includes runtime AI.
- A track record of satisfying enterprise security, governance, and data-handling requirements when shipping software in regulated or rights-sensitive domains.
- Strong stakeholder communication. You can sit with a non-technical business partner, draw out what they actually need beyond the surface ask, propose a solution with them, and own translating it into a decomposed, shippable plan in real time. The same skill carries from frontline operators through senior executives.
- Comfort operating with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements. You write, ship, and own production code; you do not hand off recommendations.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Prior Forward Deployed Engineer or embedded senior engineer experience.
- Deep experience with AI-assisted development workflows in a production setting (not just experimentation).
- Experience coaching teams through methodology shifts (DevOps adoption, agile transformations, AI-assisted development rollouts).
- Prior experience in media, entertainment, or other rights-sensitive industries.
- Experience with the EIP foundation platforms (Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI APIs) or with Moveworks / Agentic Foundation.

AV’s Specialized Exploitation & Targeting (SET) Department is seeking an entry-level Radar Exploitation Engineer to support NASIC at Wright-Patterson AFB. title: Sr. Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
About Mariana Minerals

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

The role

Mariana Minerals is looking for a Sr. or Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure to join the team that owns and collaborates on the platform every other engineer here builds on.

Our software team builds MarianaOS, the operating system for how Mariana engineers, constructs, and operates its mines and mineral processing facilities. It runs in AWS and on edge clusters at our sites, including our copper site in Moab, Utah and our lithium facility in East Texas. On any given day, it serves construction dashboards, running GPU inference on site camera feeds, training models for a lithium extraction circuit, and moving plant floor data into a warehouse.

Your team owns the platform underneath all of that: clusters, deployment, CI/CD, observability, site/edge footprint, identity, secrets, and cloud costs. You will also collaborate with machine learning engineers and data engineers on the ML compute platform and data pipeline infrastructure.

The part of this role we care most about is what you build for other people. We do not want an approval queue. When an engineer needs a database, a bucket, a dashboard, or an alert, they should get it from a documented path they can run themselves, and your job is to make that path exist and make it the easiest option. You will be measured on how much infrastructure work happens without you.

We move quickly. Our engineers ship, get feedback from the people running our plants and job sites, and iterate. Everything you build should shorten that loop.

Our stack is TypeScript and React on the front end, Node and Python services, Postgres, and AWS. The platform is EKS with Karpenter, ArgoCD, Helm, Pulumi, Prometheus and Grafana, Loki, Prefect, Snowflake, and a growing amount of LLM and agent tooling in production.

What You'll Do

Own our Kubernetes footprint end to end: the EKS cluster, the on-premises site clusters, cluster upgrades, capacity and autoscaling, ingress and DNS, and the GitOps delivery path that turns a merged commit into a running service.

Build self-service infrastructure for other engineers, so that provisioning a service, a database, a preview environment, or a scheduled job is a documented path they run themselves so the team can deliver quickly.

Make observability a default. Every deployed service should emit metrics, ship logs, trace requests, and carry meaningful alerts without its author's writing bespoke plumbing.

Extend the platform to our sites, running on-premises and edge clusters that host GPU inference and plant data collection over constrained links.

Own cloud cost as an engineering problem, with the visibility, budgets, and right-sizing to keep a growing platform from growing its bill proportionally.

Own identity, access, and secrets management, so that scoped access is provisioned and revoked as a matter of course.

Respond to infrastructure incidents and then remove the class of failure that caused them, including writing the runbook so the fix scales.

What You'll Bring

8-12+ years building and operating production infrastructure, with real depth in Kubernetes: you have run and upgraded clusters yourself and debugged multiple layers below the application.

Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write code you would be comfortable having reviewed by a product engineer, and you reach for a well-designed tool or abstraction before a runbook.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Pulumi, Terraform, or similar) and GitOps-style continuous delivery.

A track record of building platforms other engineers adopted willingly. We will ask you for specifics: what you built, who used it, and how you know it helped.

Practical observability experience with Prometheus, Grafana, and a log aggregation stack, and getting an organization to instrument its services.

Comfort operating across a broad surface with incomplete context.

Fluency in Python or TypeScript, and enough familiarity with AWS to make sound cost and architecture tradeoffs.

Experience supporting ML or data-intensive workloads (GPU scheduling, distributed training, pipeline orchestration) is a strong plus.

Experience with on-premise or edge infrastructure, industrial networks, or constrained-connectivity environments is a strong plus.

Startup experience in a rapidly scaling company is helpful but not required.

Domain experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, mining, or capital projects is beneficial but not required.

How We'll Interview

We want to see you design and build platform tooling, so the loop is weighted toward that.

Expect a conversation about a platform you have built and why you made the calls you made, a working session where you design a self-service capability for an engineering org and we push on the tradeoffs, and a hands-on exercise with infrastructure code.

Our culture is built on four principles:

Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people.

Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.

Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet.

About the Role

Job Summary
As a Radiation Effects engineer, you will serve as one of the points of contact for all technical topics related to space environment qualification and design, and meet team members' needs, customer requirements, and company goals. In this role you will serve as a focal for spacecraft electronics radiation susceptibility with the responsibility of hardening reliable space systems. This position requires deep technical expertise in radiation effects testing and analysis.

Responsibilities
You are responsible for enforcing the Radiation Hardness Assurance for our various buses, products and individual components. You will coordinate closely with all products designers to continually evolve, test, and maintain a radiation parts and materials library. You will also provide radiation analysis capabilities to ensure spacecraft shielding and electronics design is adequate for compliance to harsh environments ranging from LEO to GEO.

-
Establish and own the radiation qualification campaigns for critical new generation electronics

-
Operate radiation test equipment, including total dose sources and pulsed laser equipment

-
Provide radiation tolerant recommendations to product designers to increase probability of mission success through part selection, circuit design, passive/active radiation mitigations and mission design recommendations

-
Support business development and mission integration efforts by contributing to proposals, requirements development, customer briefings, and design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) with radiation assessments

-
Own the budget, schedule, plan, and execution of radiation test campaigns at external facilities (protons, heavy ions, gamma, neutron) or through third-party partners for specific new technologies

-
Provide unit and mission level radiation analyses including SEE rates, availability estimates, cumulative dose exposures and the associated artifacts for requirements verification

-
Maintain and grow the parts and materials library databases with critical piece-part and material information accessible to all designers

Basic Qualifications

-
B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Nuclear Engineering, or related field

-
2-5 years of experience in radiation effects and/or reliability engineering for aerospace systems

-
Expertise with radiation tools (e.g. AE9/AP9/SPM, CREME96, OMERE, SPENVIS) for environmental definition and requirements definition.

-
Familiarity with industry radiation standards (e.g. MIL-STD-750, MIL-STD-883, ECSS-Q-ST-60-15C, MIL-STD-3053 and NASA testing guidelines).

-
Experience with budgeting, scheduling and executing SEE, TID and DDD test campaigns, including test evaluation hardware/kit development and familiar with testing FPGAs and microprocessors.

-
Proficiency with data analysis and modeling software (Python, MATLAB, or equivalent).

-
Familiarity with circuit simulation tools (e.g. LTSpice) with experience in design and/or analysis of digital and analog circuits.

-
Strong lab experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, source meters, power supplies, and automating data collection.

-
Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey radiation risks and mitigation to diverse stakeholders

Preferred Skills and Experience

-
M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Reliability Engineering, or related field

-
Hands-on experience with scripting, automation, and programming languages (Python, MATLAB, JMP, C/C++, SQL, etc.)

-
Familiarity with radiation transport and shielding analysis tools (FASTRAD)

-
Familiarity with space charging effects on materials and electronics

-
Experience with anomaly resolution and documentation of anomaly reports and lessons learned databases

Why Join Apex?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.

-
Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

-
Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

-
Comprehensive PTO package to reset and recharge - starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

Competitive 401(k) plan with generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

8 weeks paid parental leave plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks to keep you fueled throughout the day

Vibrant community: Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

-
Your dream desk setup and all the tools you need to be your most productive self

-
World-class Playa Vista office with the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

-
Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference

title: Software Engineer - Inference Performance
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We're looking for inference performance engineers who want to make the world's most demanding AI workloads run faster and more efficiently. You'll work across the stack, from the inference engine and runtime through scheduling, serving, and routing. Along the way you'll apply techniques like prefill/decode disaggregation, speculative decoding, and KV-cache management. You'll reason from first principles about where time and memory go, find what's holding performance back, and close the gap. Your work directly impacts how fast our customers' models run and how efficiently we serve them. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is eager to make significant contributions to the exciting field of LLM inference.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

You'll get to work on these types of projects as an Inference Performance engineer:

-
Agentic Kernels in Production

-
How we built the new fastest API for GLM-5.2

-
Live draft model training for speculative decoding

-
Making Kimi K3 Tokenization 18x faster

-
The Baseten Inference Stack

-
Driving model performance optimization

RESPONSIBILITIES

-
Implement and productionize cutting-edge inference techniques, working deep in runtime internals. That includes quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, chunked prefill, LoRA, guided generation for structured outputs, and custom scheduling and routing algorithms.

-
Profile and optimize inference end to end, from kernel launch overhead and memory layout up to request scheduling, prefill/decode disaggregation, and cache-aware routing. Run cross-layer investigations, such as tracing a tail-latency regression from request timing through routing and batching down to a kernel.

-
Turn performance into cost savings. Improve tokens per GPU-hour, raise utilization, and give customers and internal teams clear latency/throughput/cost tradeoffs.

-
Bring up and tune new model architectures on new hardware quickly, often in the same week they're released.

-
Build benchmarking frameworks that measure real-world performance across model architectures, batch sizes, sequence lengths, and hardware configurations.

-
Contribute upstream to open-source inference engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM), and partner closely with model, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams to ship wins.

REQUIREMENTS

-
Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.

-
Experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages, such as Python or C++.

-
Familiarity with LLM optimization techniques (e.g., quantization, speculative decoding, continuous batching).

-
Strong familiarity with ML libraries, especially PyTorch, TensorRT, or TensorRT-LLM.

-
Demonstrated interest and experience in LLMs.

-
Deep understanding of GPU architecture.

NICE TO HAVE

-
Proficiency in enhancing the performance of software systems, particularly in the context of large language models (LLMs)

-
Contributed to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or another inference engine.

-
Worked on large-scale distributed serving: autoscaling, load balancing, multi-region or multi-cloud capacity.

-
Written or optimized GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, or similar)

-
Worked on quantization (FP8/FP4, AWQ, GPTQ) or speculative decoding in production.

-
Deep understanding of software engineering principles and a proven track record of developing and deploying AI/ML inference solutions.

BENEFITS

-
Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

-
(U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

-
Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

-
Paid parental leave

-
Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

-
(U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

-
Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

title: Senior Associate, Risk and Structuring Analytics
description:
What The Role Is

Clearway Energy seeks a Senior Associate of Risk and Structuring Analytics to develop top-notch quantitative models that drive BESS valuation, structured products pricing, gas generation optimization, and power market analysis, while also quantifying and monitoring the risk exposures those positions create. In this role, you will build and enhance Clearway’s internal quantitative modeling platform (CWENQuant), develop advanced BESS dispatch optimization and price forecasting models, and provide independent risk analytics — mark-to-market, value-at-risk, credit, and scenario/stress analysis — that directly inform commercial decisions across trading, origination, development, and asset management.

What You'll Be Doing

Quantitative/Economic Modeling

- Develop and deploy to production complex optimization models and quantitative analysis for BESS dispatch optimization, renewables, gas generation, and data center infrastructure projects across the US.

- Develop Stochastic or Machine Learning / Deep Learning models to forecast DA, Ancillary, and RT prices based on fundamental variables such as load, gas prices, and wind + solar generation to inform trading.

- Develop and maintain gas dispatch, HRCO, toll, and other structured pricing models; perform mark-to-market analysis; support due diligence, underwriting, and credit analytics.

- Refine vendor models or develop in-house models for capacity expansion with a view on market policy (RPS/GHG reduction), LCOEs, retirements, transmission, reliability, and demand growth.

- Benchmark models against actual operations and market outcomes to improve forecast accuracy and optimization.

- Build and enhance CWENQuant; develop data pipelines with internal and external resources; create automated workflows and market data dashboards using data science and optimization techniques.

- Design and maintain mark-to-market (MtM), Value-at-Risk (VaR), and Profit-at-Risk (PaR) frameworks across BESS, gas, and structured product positions, independent of the deal/trading desks that originate them.

- Run scenario, sensitivity, and stress-testing analyses (price shocks, volatility regimes, basis blowouts, extreme weather/renewable generation outcomes) to quantify tail risk in the portfolio.

- Quantify hedge effectiveness and basis risk for structured transactions, PPAs, and tolling/HRCO arrangements; recommend hedge adjustments.

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.

- 3+ years of quantitative or modeling experience within the energy sector, including trading firms, banks, utilities, IPPs, ISOs, or BESS companies.

- Working experience developing ML/DL models using scikit-learn, Keras, or TensorFlow.

- Experience with linear/Mixed Integer programming and associated tools like PuLP, Gurobi, CPLEX, etc.

- Strong quantitative background with deep hands-on experience coding in Python.

- Knowledge of BESS (strongly preferred), renewable, and conventional (gas) assets, HRCO, and toll modeling.

- Strong understanding of power market economics, wholesale market structure, and asset operations in ISO (CAISO, ERCOT, etc.) markets.

- Proven ability to build top-notch optimization models and stochastic or ML/DL forecasting frameworks such as price, load, or renewable generation forecasting.

- Understanding of option pricing, volatility, game theory, opportunity cost, and optimization.

- Ability to formulate and articulate viewpoints (written and verbal) in a clear, persuasive, and succinct manner.

- Ability to handle multiple concurrent efforts and provide high-quality deliverables accurately.

- Ability to work well in a fast-paced, team-oriented, collaborative environment that emphasizes attention to detail, meeting deadlines, and working together to achieve company-wide objectives.

- Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice

- Programming skills required: Python is a must; R, SQL, etc. are a plus.

- Working experience with stochastic models, mean reversion, and jump diffusion preferred.

- Exposure to ETRM systems, MtM, and VaR model validation/governance practices is a plus.

- Master’s or PhD is preferred.

title: Revenue Accounting Transformation Manager
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

Planet is seeking a high-impact Revenue Accounting Transformation Manager to lead the modernization, automation, and scalability of our global revenue engine, reporting to the Global Revenue Accounting Director.

In this role, you will stand at the intersection of technical accounting standards (ASC 606), business systems engineering, and data analytics. You will lead cross-functional transformation across the entire Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) lifecycle. From evaluating new monetization models and designing system configurations to automating audit disclosures and acting as the primary SOX compliance liaison, you will ensure our accounting operations scale effortlessly alongside business growth. You will serve as the architectural bridge between commercial innovation, technical revenue compliance, and automated data pipelines—ensuring the company scales rapidly without sacrificing auditability or operational speed.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

- System Architecture: Lead the design and configuration of automated revenue subledgers.

- Q2C Streamlining: Modernize end-to-end Quote-to-Cash workflows to eliminate manual journal entries, eradicate spreadsheet risks, and shorten month-end close cycles.

- Cross-System Data Alignment: Collaborate with cross functional teams to integrate revenue data across ERP, subledgers, and data warehouses.

- Commercial Strategy Engagement: Partner with Product, Sales Ops, and Pricing teams to evaluate systems impact and revenue rules (ASC 606) for new products and monetization models.

- Audit Ownership: Serve as the primary liaison for internal and external auditors on revenue systems, process changes, and automation workflows.

- Standards Adherence: Ensure all automated system rules, data flows, and manual overrides remain strictly compliant with ASC 606.

- Change Management: Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and train finance teams on updated system workflows.

title: Manager, Solutions Engineering – Commercial, Emerging Industries
description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role

Skydio is seeking a Solutions Engineering leader to run the Emerging Industries team, the group responsible for turning promising use cases into repeatable, scalable businesses. You will lead a team of quota-bearing Solutions Engineers who operate at the front edge of the market: scoping and executing proofs of concept, defining success criteria where none exist, validating new hardware, software, and workflows, and determining whether a use case is real before the company invests behind it.

In addition to the Emerging Industries team, you will manage Solutions Engineers who support Skydio's high-leverage sales channels and our Inside Sales Representatives (ISRs). These roles extend Solutions Engineering coverage through partners and high-velocity sales motions, and they require a different operating model than field POCs: scalable enablement, fast technical qualification, and repeatable assets over bespoke engagements.

This is a remote role. Travel of up to 50% is required to support customer engagements, POCs, field validation, partner activities, and company events.

This role reports to the Director, Solutions Engineering – Commercial.

About the Team

The Commercial Solutions Engineering team is the technical authority behind every commercial engagement. We sit between the customer and the product: running technical discovery, designing solutions, executing paid dock trials, and carrying customers from a first site through fleet-wide rollout.

The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, and the quality of requirements we push back into the product organization. Solutions Engineers operate against a shared quota with their sales counterparts, and Solutions Specialists provide domain depth as an overlay across segments.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio Sales organization and work closely with Account Executives, Inside Sales Representatives, Partner and Rental teams, Solutions Specialists, Deployment Engineers, and the Launch Team to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of commercial UAS programs.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Lead the team

-
Hire, develop, and retain a team of Solutions Engineers with complementary domain coverage across target segments.

-
Build the qualification framework for new use cases and industries: what gets a POC, what gets a deferral, and what evidence is required to move a segment from exploratory to funded.

-
Own team productivity, engagement, and growth. Serve as the decision-maker for Solutions Engineering capacity within your segment: set priorities for where the team's time goes, decline requests that don't meet the bar, and keep Sales leadership informed of the tradeoffs behind each call.

-
Develop people beyond the seat they are in, including career paths, promotion cases, and succession inside your team.

Drive technical wins

-
Own technical win rate for Emerging Industries and partner with segment sales leadership on pipeline health and quota attainment.

-
Lead POC and pilot design across oil and gas including optical gas imaging and methane detection, construction and AEC progress documentation, survey and mapping, mining, and logistics and distribution.

-
Work with GTM, Marketing, and Sales leadership to shape segment definitions, target account lists, and go-to-market plays as the commercial segmentation model evolves.

Own the emerging industries problem set

-
Maintain team fluency in survey and mapping workflows: photogrammetry, PPK and RTK, 3D scan, survey-grade accuracy standards, and 3D data deliverables.

-
Partner with vendors and Product on payload and sensor requirements for new workflows; define constraints and acceptance criteria.

title: Manager of Business Analytics, Fraud Ops Automation
description:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

About the Role

Koalafi's Fraud Operations team is the front line of our fraud defense. Our investigators review high-risk merchants and customers every day, from merchant underwriting to real-time investigations of consumer financing applicants. As we scale, we are investing in tools, processes, and AI to make that front line faster, smarter, and more consistent. The Manager, Fraud Operations Automation will be the embedded analytical and automation engine of the Fraud Operations team. This is not a “fraud investigator only” role. You will bring the fraud domain intelligence that drives our operations, pinpoint where investigators spend time on manual, repetitive work, and convert those processes into data-driven, automated, and AI-assisted workflows. The result: investigators get the insights they need to act on the right cases at the right time. You will sit within Fraud Operations and work shoulder to shoulder with our investigators, while partnering closely with the Fraud Strategy & Analytics team on high-priority initiatives.

What You'll Do

AI-Driven Workflow Automation
Lead the design and build of AI agents and automated workflows that reduce manual effort across Fraud Operations.

- Build and deploy AI agents that automate manual investigative processes, including merchant underwriting and real-time suspicious customer investigations.

- Map current investigative workflows end-to-end, identify the highest-value automation opportunities, and deliver solutions that measurably reduce handle time and improve decision consistency.

- Partner with Engineering, Data, and Fraud Strategy & Analytics to move AI and automation solutions from prototype to production, in line with Koalafi's long-term AI strategy.

- Establish guardrails, quality checks, and human-in-the-loop controls so automated decisions remain accurate, explainable, and auditable.

Investigative Insights & Proactive Detection
Give Fraud Operations on-demand and proactive visibility into suspicious activity.

- Deliver on-demand analysis on suspicious merchants and customers to support active investigations and escalations.

- Proactively surface emerging fraud patterns, high-risk merchants, and linked customer activity before they become losses.

- Build data-driven prioritization so investigators focus on the highest-risk cases first.

- Support merchant monitoring with analytical deep dives that complement the policies and models owned by Fraud Strategy & Analytics.

Operational Reporting & Dashboards
Build the reporting backbone for Fraud Operations.

- Design and maintain dashboards tracking investigator productivity, queue health, case outcomes, underwriting throughput, and fraud trends.

- Replace manual, spreadsheet-based reporting with automated, reliable reporting.

- Develop ad hoc reports for Fraud Operations leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Define and track operational KPIs such as time to decision, false positive rates, and investigator capacity.

Cross-Functional Partnership
Serve as the bridge between Fraud Operations and Koalafi's analytics, product, and technology teams.

- Partner with Fraud Strategy & Analytics to translate front-line investigative findings into rule, policy, and model improvements, and to ensure manual review aligns with policy intent.

- Work with Product and Engineering to embed automation and data tools into case management and merchant update workflows (including JIRA).

- Communicate findings clearly to investigators, leadership, and partner teams, and help drive projects from idea to delivery.

About You (Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree required, preferably in a quantitative or technical field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or Data Science.

- At least 5 years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related role in Fraud domain.

- Strong proficiency in SQL and lightweight Python; comfortable working with large, unstructured datasets.

- Hands-on fluency in building AI agents and LLM-based workflows (for example, using frameworks and APIs from leading AI providers) to automate manual, judgment-heavy processes.

- Experience building dashboards and visualizations in tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar.

- A builder's mindset: you get excited about finding manual processes and automating them.

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to explain technical work to non-technical partners.

- Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, remote-first environment.

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with case management tools, JIRA, and workflow orchestration.

- Experience with anomaly detection, entity resolution, or link analysis.

- Experience in consumer finance, lending, lease-to-own, BNPL, payments, or fintech.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Clinical Analytics
description:
Principal Software Engineer - Clinical Analytics

Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.

This position is based out of our headquarters in the Greater Seattle area. #LI-hybrid

Who We Need

Truveta is building a diverse and inclusive team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking enthusiastic new graduates who are problem-solvers, collaborative teammates, and eager to make a difference in healthcare. If you’re excited about purposeful work, joining a mission-driven team, and launching your career in a supportive environment, Truveta could be the perfect place to start.

This Opportunity

At Truveta, you'll help define how health systems use data to improve the quality of care. You'll work at the intersection of cloud services, analytical data platforms, and user experiences, setting the technical direction for technology that lets clinical and quality teams define, monitor, and act on the metrics that matter most.

Health systems deserve modern, intuitive tools for measuring care quality, yet getting answers from large-scale clinical data still often takes specialized skills and long turnaround times. At Truveta, we are building a next-generation analytics platform that lets health systems securely explore their data, track performance over time, and drive measurable improvements in patient outcomes.

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the architecture and technical strategy of Truveta's clinical analytics platform. You will be both a hands-on builder and a force multiplier: designing the systems that power low-latency analytics and self-serve dashboarding, writing critical code, raising the engineering bar, and mentoring engineers across the organization.

You will partner with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering leadership to translate the needs of health systems into a durable platform vision, then guide teams in delivering it. This role offers the opportunity to shape a foundational product area, tackle ambiguous and technically demanding problems, and make a meaningful impact on our mission of saving lives with data.

Work Areas:

- Define the end-to-end architecture for clinical analytics: analytical data serving, metric definition and computation, and self-serve dashboarding and visualization for health systems.

- Make foundational design decisions on OLAP and analytical storage, data modeling, query performance, caching, and scalability for population-level health data.

- Design secure multi-tenant systems with strong data isolation, fine-grained access control, and auditability appropriate for sensitive health data.

- Determine how health systems define, customize, and share their own metrics and dashboards, balancing flexibility with governance, performance, and cost.

- Build and prototype critical components, set technical standards, and lead design and code reviews across teams.

- Mentor and grow engineers, and partner with other engineering leaders to align roadmaps and reduce technical risk across the broader Truveta data platform.

- Establish engineering practices for reliability, observability, and operational excellence in production analytics services.

Key Qualifications

- BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 12+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale software systems, with a track record of technical leadership on complex, multi-team initiatives.

- Deep experience with data, OLAP, or analytics technologies, including analytical databases, BI and dashboarding platforms, and data modeling for high-performance reporting workloads.

- Strong backend engineering expertise in .NET (C#), Python, or a similar language, including REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures on platforms such as Azure.

- Demonstrated ability to make and communicate sound architectural tradeoffs, and to drive alignment among engineering, product, and executive stakeholders.

- Proven experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical capability of a team.

- Strong communication skills, including the ability to write clear technical design documents and explain complex systems to diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building embedded analytics, self-serve BI, or data-driven products for technical or business users.

- Experience with multi-tenant architectures, including row-level security and tenant isolation, in regulated or sensitive-data environments.

- Familiarity with healthcare data, clinical quality measures, or health informatics.

- Experience with containerized deployments, infrastructure as code, and operating high-availability production services.

- Experience applying AI or natural-language interfaces to analytics and data exploration.
