title: Sr. Program Intelligence & Performance Management Consultant
description:
Government Employees Health Association, Inc. (G.E.H.A) is a nonprofit member association that provides health and dental benefits that millions of federal employees and retirees, military retirees and their families have counted on since 1937. Offering one of the largest health and dental benefit provider networks available to federal employees in the United States, G.E.H.A empowers health and wellness by meeting its members where they are, when they need care.

G.E.H.A has one mission: To empower federal workers to be healthy and well.

The Senior Program Intelligence & Performance Management Consultant is a senior individual contributor responsible for defining, owning, and communicating the holistic performance narrative of G.E.H.A's ancillary product portfolio, including dental and vision lines of business. This role sits at the intersection of program strategy, regulatory reporting, and cross-functional data synthesis, translating inputs from the TPA, network, actuarial, finance, and operations teams into decision-ready intelligence for executive leadership and OPM.

The Senior Program Intelligence & Performance Management Consultant defines what program success looks like, establishes the measurement framework to track it, and ensures that G.E.H.A's leadership, and its federal regulator, always has a clear, accurate, and compelling view of program performance. The role partners directly with the product team to support OPM reporting obligations, Corrective Action Plan (CAP) evidence packages (where applicable), regulatory submissions, and builds the analytical foundation for new product launches before they go live.

As the recognized subject matter authority for ancillary program performance measurement, the role operates with limited oversight, exercises independent judgment on matters of significance, and serves as a technical advisor and mentor to other professionals engaged in reporting and analytics work. Recommendations made by this role directly influence executive decisions on program strategy, vendor performance management, and regulatory positioning.

SKILLS

Duties & Responsibilities

Program Performance Framework & Measurement Governance

- Define and own the performance measurement framework for G.E.H.A's ancillary product portfolio — establishing the KPIs, benchmarks, thresholds, and leading indicators that reflect true program health across dental, vision, and future ancillary lines of business.

- Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure the program scorecard aligns with G.E.H.A's strategic priorities and OPM contractual obligations.

- Proactively identify gaps in current measurement, data that G.E.H.A should be tracking but isn't, and work with enterprise Data & Analytics to build those capabilities.

- Establish baseline performance assumptions for any new product lines prior to launch, creating the measurement infrastructure before the first member enrolls.

- Own the definitional standards, calculation methodologies, and data-quality criteria underpinning program metrics, serving as the final authority on how ancillary program performance is measured and reported.

OPM Reporting & Regulatory Support

- Serve as the accountable owner for all OPM-required performance reporting, including annual submissions, CAP evidence packages, mid-year performance updates, and ad hoc OPM data requests.

- Translate program performance data into OPM-ready narrative — clear, accurate, and structured to meet federal regulatory standards and demonstrate program accountability.

- Maintain a regulatory reporting calendar and ensure all submission deadlines are met with sufficient lead time for review and quality assurance.

- Support OPM site visit preparation by assembling performance evidence, identifying potential areas of scrutiny, and recommending proactive disclosures.

- Advise leadership on regulatory reporting risk, including exposure created by data limitations or performance trends, and recommend mitigation strategies in advance of federal review.

Cross-Functional Program Intelligence & Executive Reporting

- Serve as the single point of synthesis across TPA operational reports, CDN network performance data, actuarial financial summaries, enterprise D&A dashboards, and member satisfaction inputs, producing a unified program intelligence view for management and executive leadership.

- Establish a structured cadence for collecting performance inputs from cross-functional partners and hold those partners accountable to timely, accurate data delivery.

- Identify discrepancies, anomalies, risks, and emerging trends across data sources; surface findings with context, implications, and recommended actions.

- Produce decision-ready performance packages, dashboards, and summaries for management and executives on a defined reporting cadence, translating data into clear strategic narrative.

- Support Board-level reporting on dental product performance as requested and ensure reporting demonstrates CAP progress, program accountability, and regulatory compliance throughout the plan year.

Strategic Decision Support & Executive Advisory

- Advise the Director and senior leadership on program performance implications, presenting options, trade-offs, and recommended courses of action on matters affecting program strategy and regulatory standing.

- Develop analytical business cases supporting benefit design changes, vendor performance interventions, and program investment decisions.

- Lead performance deep-dives into emerging issues, determining root cause across operational, network, and financial data, and recommending corrective action to accountable owners.

- Represent the ancillary program in enterprise forums where performance data informs cross-departmental decisions.

Analytical Standards & Mentorship

- Establish and maintain reporting standards, documentation practices, and quality-assurance protocols adopted by others who produce program reporting.

- Coach and review the analytical work of less experienced professionals and cross-functional contributors, elevating the quality and consistency of program reporting enterprise-wide.

- Serve as the escalation point for complex analytical questions regarding ancillary program performance, methodology disputes, and data interpretation.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Health Informatics, Public Administration, Statistics, or a related field required, Master's degree preferred.

- Additional years of qualifying relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.

- Requires a minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in program reporting, performance management, or health plan analytics — with demonstrated ownership of reporting frameworks, not just execution of assigned reports, including at least 2 years in a lead, senior, or principal capacity.

- Exceptional written communication and data storytelling skills — the ability to translate complex, multi-source performance data into clear, compelling narrative for executive and regulatory audiences.

- Strategic analytical mindset: asks 'what should we be measuring and why' before 'how do we pull the data.'

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; able to hold partners in finance, actuarial, operations, and D&A accountable to reporting inputs without direct authority.

- High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; advanced proficiency with Power BI or comparable enterprise visualization platforms required, including data modeling and the design of self-service reporting for executive audiences

- Organized, deadline-driven, and highly reliable — manages multiple concurrent reporting obligations across regulatory, executive, and operational audiences.

- Comfortable operating in a lean, high-accountability team environment where initiative and ownership are expected without prompting.

- Exercises independent judgment on matters of significance, determining methods and approaches without established precedent and operating with limited managerial oversight.

- Demonstrated experience synthesizing data from multiple sources — TPA, network, financial, operational — into cohesive program-level performance narratives.

- Demonstrated experience advising senior leadership on performance matters and influencing decisions through analytical recommendation.

- Experience establishing measurement standards and coaching, mentoring, or elevating the analytical capability of others while maintaining credibility as the program’s technical authority.

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience supporting OPM, CMS, or other federal regulatory reporting obligations strongly preferred; FEDVIP or FEHB program experience is a significant advantage.

- Knowledge of federal health benefit program structure, OPM reporting expectations, or government contracting compliance preferred.

- Experience working in or alongside a dental or vision insurance program preferred; familiarity with dental benefit structures, CDT coding, or managed care financial metrics (loss ratio, PMPM, premium rate regions) a strong plus.

Work-at-home requirements

Must have the ability to provide a non-cellular High Speed Internet Service such as Fiber, DSL, or cable Modems for a home office.

A minimum standard speed for optimal performance of 30x5 (30mpbs download x 5mpbs upload) is required.

A dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

Robust employee well-being program

Paid Time Off

Personal Community Enrichment Time

Company-provided Basic Life and AD&D

Tuition Assistance Program

title: Assistant Director, Enrollment Data Systems CRM
description:
Job Title:
Assistant Director, Enrollment Data Systems CRM

Job Summary:
The Assistant Director of Enrollment Data Systems (AD) serves as a subject matter expert in Strategic Enrollment Management (SEM) data systems, with a focus on quality assurance, system integrations, data integrity, and Slate administration. The AD supports the Undergraduate (UG), Graduate (GRAD), and Certificate (CERT) Slate environments and works collaboratively with the Enrollment Data Systems team and University stakeholders to monitor and maintain the systems and data processes supporting enrollment operations.

A primary focus of the position is shared monitoring and quality assurance across USF’s enrollment technology ecosystem, including data movement between Slate, Axiom Elite, and Ellucian Banner; established intra- and inter-system validation controls; major third-party and AI-assisted application integrations; and person and application-level fraud and anomaly detection. The AD investigates system and data exceptions/errors, supports established SQL, Tableau, and Slate-based monitoring processes, and recommends enhancements as business requirements, integrations, and emerging risks evolve.

The AD also provides functional and technical support for SEM operations and high-level support for USF’s decentralized Graduate Schools and Colleges and professional programs, while supporting SEM’s responsibility for shared integrations and enterprise enrollment processes. The position emphasizes collaboration, proactive monitoring, root-cause analysis, continuous improvement, and the development and sharing of innovative enrollment technology practices. The AD reports to the Senior Associate Director of Enrollment Data Systems, CRM.

Full Job Description:

Job Responsibilities

Slate Administration & Enrollment Systems Support

- Provide functional and technical Slate support for SEM departments, including Undergraduate Enrollment Operations, Undergraduate Admissions, and Undergraduate Enrollment Communications.

- Provide functional and technical Slate support for the decentralized Graduate Schools and Colleges (GRAD), including the Certificate (CERT) Slate instance supporting USF’s professional programs, with SEM maintaining responsibility and authority for integration-related enhancements, maintenance, configuration, and modifications affecting enterprise systems, data exchanges, and shared enrollment processes.

Data Quality Assurance - Slate, Axiom Elite, & Ellucian Banner

- Share responsibility for the daily validation and monitoring of Axiom integrations across the Undergraduate (UG), Graduate (GRAD), and Certificate (CERT) Slate instances, working collaboratively with other Enrollment Data Systems team members and appropriate stakeholders to monitor the successful movement of application, test score, school, decision, and other enrollment data between Slate, Axiom, and Ellucian Banner.

- Share responsibility for investigating and resolving Axiom and related integration errors/exceptions across the Undergraduate (UG), Graduate (GRAD), and Certificate (CERT) Slate instances, working collaboratively with other Enrollment Data Systems team members and appropriate stakeholders to trace records across Slate, Axiom, and Banner; identify points of failure; correct source data, mappings, or system logic when appropriate; and validate successful downstream processing.

- Share responsibility for monitoring established cross-system data integrity audits across the Undergraduate (UG), Graduate (GRAD), and Certificate (CERT) Slate instances, comparing live Slate data against live Ellucian Banner data using tools such as Tableau, SQL-based reporting, and other institutional data-validation tools.

- Share responsibility for monitoring and maintaining established Undergraduate (UG) equilibrium-method scholarship quality-assurance queries and controls, including intra-Slate validation of scholarship eligibility, calculations, and assigned awards, as well as inter-system validation between Slate and Banner to ensure scholarship data is accurately reflected across systems.

Person and Application Fraud Quality Assurance

- Co-monitor established system controls, metrics, and automated detection processes across the Undergraduate and Graduate Slate instances, in collaboration with the Enrollment Data Systems team, SEM stakeholders, and the decentralized Graduate Schools and Colleges. Monitoring includes person-level spam and anomalous activity, including SMS/text messaging patterns and usage, as well as application-level fraudulent, anomalous, and Ghost application activity.

- Monitor evolving spam and application fraud trends, patterns, and attack methods, and proactively recommend new or enhanced detection and prevention methodologies as behaviors change.

- Evaluate and recommend enhancements to queries, rules, scoring methodologies, reports, integrations, and automated controls to address emerging risks and strengthen data quality and system protections.

Integration Quality Assurance - Third-Party Systems

- Co-monitor established application-level auditing and reconciliation processes for major bilateral application integrations within the Undergraduate Slate instance, including AI-assisted application review integrations and other systems that transmit application information externally and return structured information to Slate.

Data Analysis, Continuous Improvement & Compliance

- Maintain and advance professional knowledge through active participation in Slate Summit and other relevant conferences, training opportunities, documentation, and professional communities, with an emphasis on contributing to USF’s strong tradition of presenting at Summit and sharing innovative practices with the broader Slate community.

- Use data and systems analysis to identify opportunities to improve, automate, and strengthen enrollment business processes, collaborating with appropriate stakeholders to develop and implement recommendations.

- Ensure the integrity and confidentiality of student academic and applicant records by complying with FERPA, University policies, and applicable data-governance requirements.

- Perform other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree required.

- Understanding of and commitment to the University of San Francisco’s Vision, Mission, and Values.
-

- Experience with and demonstrated ability to work effectively with a diverse student body, faculty, and staff.

- Strong equity lens, cultural humility, and demonstrated ability to work effectively in a diverse environment.

- 1–3 years of experience working in university enrollment management, enrollment technology, CRM administration, student information systems, or a related area.

- At least one year of administrative experience with Technolutions Slate CRM required.

- Demonstrated understanding of Slate Configurable Joins, queries, exports, filters, and data structures.

- Experience working with Slate functionality including queries, reports, application cycle preparation, Deliver, rules and populations, forms, Reader, Inbox, events, portals, and integrations.

- Demonstrated experience using SQL or SQL-based query tools for data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and reporting.

- Working knowledge of Student Information Systems and the movement of data between CRM, middleware, SIS, and third-party platforms.

- Demonstrated ability to investigate complex data or integration issues by tracing records across multiple systems and identifying root causes.

- Experience with data-quality assurance, exception reporting, reconciliation, or other systematic approaches to validating data integrity.

- Data reporting and analysis experience required.

- Demonstrated experience configuring and editing Liquid Markup.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into appropriate technical or process solutions.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear language for functional stakeholders.

- Demonstrated ability to independently manage recurring operational monitoring, investigate exceptions, prioritize issues, and follow problems through resolution.

- Strong desire and aptitude to continue developing technical and professional expertise within SEM.

Preferred Qualifications

- 1–2 years of experience administering Technolutions Slate CRM or serving as a Slate Captain.

- Experience using Axiom Elite or comparable middleware/integration platforms supporting enrollment or student information systems.

- Experience as a functional user of Ellucian Banner, including Banner Student.

- Experience writing SQL for data reconciliation, exception detection, integration monitoring, or quality assurance.

- Experience using Tableau or comparable business intelligence and visualization tools to monitor and reconcile data across enterprise systems.

- Experience supporting or monitoring API, file-based, middleware, or bilateral system integrations.

- Experience developing automated controls or monitoring processes for data quality, system exceptions, anomalous records, fraud/spam detection, or integration health.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted or other emerging enrollment technology integrations and the quality-assurance considerations associated with exchanging application data with third-party systems.

- Familiarity with XML, HTML, CSS, and other technologies commonly used within Slate.

- Understanding of Oracle table structures and Oracle ODS.

- Project management skills and experience.

- Familiarity with University of San Francisco enrollment processes, policies, and culture.

title: Sr Analyst, Data Integrity, Enablement & Validation
description:
Champion trusted data that drives confident decisions

In this role, you help ensure that every business insight across Resmed is built on reliable, transparent, and well‑understood data. As part of the Data Insights team within our Commercial Insights and Data Science organization, you connect data sources, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to create a single version of truth. Your work supports smarter decisions that help us deliver innovative solutions to patients, providers, and partners.

You will bring clarity to complex data landscapes—supporting the development and adoption of standardized metrics, validating data quality, reconciling inconsistencies, and embedding repeatable integrity checks that enhance confidence in analytics and enterprise reporting. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise with business understanding and communication skills to translate complex data issues into clear findings, recommendations, and solutions; hence enabling the entire organization to make decisions based on trusted information.

What You’ll Do

- Partner with business, analytics, product, and technical stakeholders to define data requirements, metric definitions, business rules, and use cases.
- Validate internal and external data sources for accuracy, consistency, completeness, and usability with minimal supervision.
- Investigate and reconcile discrepancies across multiple datasets and reporting environments, identify root causes and recommend remediation.
- Develop, maintain, and enhance repeatable validation processes, reconciliation methodologies, and quality controls for critical business data.
- Validate new datasets, metrics, dashboards, and analytical products prior to broader adoption, and collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to address upstream data quality issues.
- Monitor key datasets and metrics for anomalies, gaps, unexpected changes, and emerging data quality concerns, and develop reporting tools that provide visibility into data integrity.
- Support the development and governance of standardized enterprise metrics, definitions, and business rules, while maintaining clear documentation of data sources, lineage, methodologies, assumptions, and limitations.

- Enable analysts and business partners to effectively access, understand, and use trusted data for analysis and insights-generation.
- Translate complex technical findings into clear, non-technical language for business stakeholders and leadership to support informed decision-making.

What You Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in information technology, data analytics, computer science, finance, statistics, business, or related field.
- 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data quality, data governance, or related analytical discipline.
- Proficiency in SQL for investigating, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, validating, reconciling, and analyzing large and complex datasets across multiple systems.
- Strong understanding of relational databases, data warehousing, data pipelines, and enterprise reporting environments, with the ability to connect technical data structures to underlying business processes.
- Proven experience developing and applying data validation processes, quality assurance, business rules, and/or data governance practices in a business setting, to improve data accuracy and reliability.
- Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to clearly communicate complex data issues, methodologies, and findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Strong interpersonal, collaboration, organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with the ability to work effectively and influence across teams without direct authority.
- Experience within healthcare, medical devices, or other complex data environments preferred.

What Sets You Apart

- Data Stewardship Mindset - You treat data as a business asset and drive integrity across systems and teams.
- Analytical Curiosity - You dig deep into data patterns and anomalies to uncover root causes.
- Clear Communicator - You make complex data stories understandable and actionable for any audience.
- Collaborative Approach - You build relationships across functions to align on definitions and outcomes.
- Systems Thinker - You connect upstream sources to downstream analytics and reporting impacts.
- Continuous Improver - You seek ways to enhance processes and ensure ongoing data reliability.

Why Join Resmed

At Resmed, your work helps shape how data supports better health outcomes worldwide. You’ll be part of a team that values collaboration, precision, and innovation through actionable insights. We believe trusted data leads to trusted decisions—and that confidence ultimately benefits patients, providers, and partners.

Assistant Vice President, Advancement Transformation
University of Southern California | University Advancement

The Opportunity

The University of Southern California (USC) seeks an innovative and accomplished transformation leader to serve as Assistant Vice President, Advancement Transformation, a senior leadership role helping shape the future of USC Advancement.

As philanthropy, alumni engagement, data, artificial intelligence, and digital experiences evolve, USC Advancement is investing in the capabilities needed to become an increasingly connected, data-driven, and technology-enabled organization. The AVP will lead the vision and execution of a transformation strategy spanning people, processes, data, technology, and organizational design.

Reporting to the Associate Senior Vice President for Advancement, Alumni Relations, the AVP will serve as a strategic advisor and transformation leader across philanthropy, alumni engagement, communications, stewardship, operations, and technology. This leader will assess how Advancement works today, anticipate how the field and its enabling technologies are evolving, and translate that vision into an actionable roadmap that strengthens organizational performance, donor experience, alumni engagement, and fundraising effectiveness.

This is an opportunity for a leader who can operate at both the visionary and executional levels, imagining what the next generation of Advancement can become while building the structures, capabilities, partnerships, and momentum required to make that future real.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Transformation & Future-State Strategy

- Lead USC Advancement’s transformation strategy and roadmap across people, processes, data, technology, organizational structure, and operating models.
- Identify emerging trends in philanthropy, alumni engagement, analytics, AI, digital experience, and organizational effectiveness and translate them into actionable strategies.
- Advise senior leadership on long-range transformation priorities, innovation opportunities, and the capabilities needed to position Advancement for the future.
- Foster continuous improvement, data-informed decision-making, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration.

Organizational Assessment & Operating Model Transformation

- Through the lens of AI and technology, assess Advancement’s organizational structure, workflows, and performance model to identify opportunities for greater effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability.
- Design and test future-state organizational and operating models aligned with pipeline accountability, donor experience, alumni engagement, and institutional priorities.
- Identify and pilot opportunities to modernize business processes, reduce unnecessary complexity, and translate transformation priorities into practical, sustainable improvements.

Data, Analytics, AI & Digital Enablement

- Direct the development and adoption of advanced data, analytics, and AI capabilities, including alumni engagement, predictive modeling, next-best-action strategies, stewardship personalization, and forecasting.
- Evaluate and recommend a future-state approach that maximizes the value of USC Advancement’s CRM, reduces reliance on workarounds outside core systems, and advances modern data-management practices.
- Help shape a flexible and scalable digital and data architecture that enables systems and information to work together effectively, partnering closely with Advancement IT and university partners.

Transformation Governance, Change & Value Realization

- Establish governance frameworks, KPIs, and operating rhythms to monitor transformation progress, measure outcomes, and maintain alignment with organizational goals.
- Lead change-management strategies that build understanding, engagement, adoption, and sustained use of new processes, systems, and capabilities.
- Measure transformation value through productivity, operational efficiency, fundraising effectiveness, pipeline strength, alumni engagement, and other organizational outcomes.
- Build partnerships across Advancement and the university to advance shared transformation priorities.

Executive & Organizational Leadership

- Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior Advancement leadership, bringing a forward-looking perspective to organizational strategy, innovation, data, technology, and operational effectiveness.
- Provide leadership and direction for the Advancement Transformation team, establishing priorities and building the capabilities needed to advance transformation across USC Advancement.
- Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives requiring alignment across organizational boundaries and competing priorities.
- Manage resources and priorities to ensure transformation investments align with institutional goals and measurable outcomes.

The Impact

The Assistant Vice President will help establish the organizational, data, technology, and AI foundations needed for USC Advancement to thrive well into the future. The AVP will develop and operationalize a comprehensive transformation roadmap while partnering with Advancement teams on near-term opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Over time, this work will strengthen fundraising productivity, pipeline performance, alumni engagement, decision-making, and the ability of Advancement teams to focus their time and expertise where they can create the greatest value.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree required
- Ten years of relevant experience in higher education, enterprise transformation, analytics, digital modernization, or related fields, including at least eight years of management experience.
- Demonstrated experience leading complex transformation or teams, change management, or technology-enabled initiatives and driving successful adoption of new programs, services, or capabilities.
- Expertise using data, business modeling, visualization, and key performance indicators to generate insights and inform organizational strategy and decision-making.
- Significant executive program and project leadership experience, including defining requirements, managing complex cross-functional initiatives, and exercising sound financial management.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate complex organizational challenges into actionable strategies and solutions.
- Demonstrated leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish credibility, build alignment, and collaborate effectively across a complex organization.
- Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with executive leaders, technical partners, and diverse internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master’s degree preferred.
- Ten years of relevant experience advancement, including at least eight years of management experience.
- Experience serving in a senior administrative or executive leadership role with responsibility for organizational strategy, budgets, resources, and operational performance.
- Demonstrated expertise in process mapping, organizational effectiveness, and translating strategy into disciplined execution.

In addition, the successful candidate must also demonstrate, through ideas, words and actions, a strong commitment to USC’s Unifying Values of integrity, excellence, community, well-being, open communication, and accountability.

About USC Advancement

USC Advancement is committed to strengthening the relationships and resources that advance the university’s academic mission and create meaningful connections across the Trojan Family. The division brings together philanthropy, alumni engagement, communications, stewardship, operations, technology, and other functions in support of USC’s priorities and its global community.

The Assistant Vice President, Advancement Transformation will join USC at an important moment of investment and evolution, with the opportunity to help build the capabilities that will shape how Advancement operates, engages its constituents, and supports the university for years to come.

description:
Position Type:

If you’re looking for a fulfilling career that can make a real difference in your life, and the lives of others, you’ve come to the right place.

As a national health solutions partner, we put people first in everything we do — and that begins with our team of 8,000+ professionals who bring a cross-section of diverse life experiences and career expertise to Medavie. By collaborating and innovating together, our employees are creating industry-leading solutions in insurance, primary care and emergency medical services that impact millions of lives in Canada each year.

Our mission is to improve the wellbeing of Canadians so that every life can be lived to the fullest — and it’s reflected in our award-winning culture. We celebrate individuality and value the diverse perspectives and skills our employees contribute. We go beyond providing competitive pay and comprehensive benefits to offer opportunities for personal and professional growth, flexible work options, meaningful experiences, and supportive leadership. Medavie is where employees can be their best selves, feel they belong, and achieve their full potential. Be part of it by applying for a position with us today.

The Opportunity

Medavie is looking for a business-focused Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (DAA) Consultant who can translate business needs into clear, high-value opportunities. As part of the Enterprise Transformation Office, you will serve as a trusted connection between Business areas and Shared Services and Medavie's enterprise DAA functions, supporting opportunities from initial identification through delivery, adoption, and value realization.

In this highly collaborative role, you will act as a strategic business advisor, using advanced facilitation, business analysis, and business case development expertise to uncover opportunities across the value chain. You will lead structured conversations with business leaders and subject matter experts to identify challenges, clarify desired outcomes, assess process improvement opportunities, and shape them into compelling DAA use cases and investment proposals.

A key focus of the role is helping business leaders make informed decisions by developing clear business cases that articulate expected benefits, costs, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and value realization measures. You will help quantify potential business outcomes, assess investment rationale, and build the evidence required to support enterprise prioritization and funding decisions.

Working closely with Technology Consultants, AI and Data specialists, business leaders, and delivery partners, you will help ensure opportunities are well-defined, understood, and positioned for successful enterprise assessment. Success in this role requires strong business judgment, exceptional facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills, practical AI and data fluency, and the ability to build credibility across both business and technical audiences.

You will give Divisions and Shared Services a strong voice in shaping Medavie's enterprise DAA agenda while helping ensure solutions deliver measurable business value and sustainable adoption.

What You Will Do

- Act as a trusted front door between a Business Division or Shared Service and enterprise DAA functions, partnering closely with Technology Consultants in AI and Data throughout the idea lifecycle.
- Plan and facilitate structured discovery sessions, workshops and stakeholder discussions to uncover business needs, align perspectives, resolve ambiguity and build shared understanding of desired outcomes.
- Build a deep understanding of divisional strategy, priorities, operations, workflows and performance measures to identify unmet needs, repeated effort, delays, handoffs, decision bottlenecks, and customer or employee pain points.
- Surface and shape DAA opportunities that connect divisional needs and intended outcomes to enterprise strategy and priority value areas.
- Develop and document clear, decision-ready business cases, including the problem statement, options considered, expected benefits, costs, value drivers, assumptions, risks, dependencies and investment rationale.
- Partner with business, Finance and other specialists to quantify benefits and costs, assess trade-offs, and establish practical measures for tracking value realization.
- Elicit, analyze and document business requirements, process impacts and success measures using a senior business analyst approach.
- Confirm that opportunities are clear, meaningful and value oriented before they move forward for enterprise assessment and prioritization.
- Help connect and cluster related use cases that address broader end-to-end challenges across the value chain.
- Guide well-shaped use cases through the enterprise process and into delivery, engaging specialists in areas such as process reengineering, risk and finance when needed.
- Support sustained adoption and integration of DAA solutions so they achieve intended business outcomes and captured value.
- Translate business problems into data, analytics, automation and AI opportunities while preserving the business context as ideas move through the enterprise DAA process.
- Maintain two-way alignment by bringing business priorities, decisions, constraints and feedback to the Enterprise Transformation Office, and communicating enterprise direction, sequencing, progress and enablement needs back to the business.
- Stay current with emerging DAA capabilities, including generative AI, and continuously improve how opportunities are identified, framed and prepared for decision-making.

Manufacturing Associate - LC Column Manufacturing & Process Development

We are seeking a highly motivated Manufacturing Associate to support Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) activities focused on liquid chromatography (LC) column manufacturing. - Contribute to process characterization and process understanding activities by correlating manufacturing parameters with column performance outcomes.
- Identify opportunities to improve process capability, product consistency, manufacturing throughput, and yield.

description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Memory Systems Architecture team defines the next generation of High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) solutions that power artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, and data center applications. The team drives architectural innovation across memory systems, controllers, interfaces, and reliability features to deliver industry-leading performance, scalability, and efficiency for future computing platforms.

As a Memory Systems Architecture Intern, you will contribute to the architecture and microarchitecture development of future HBM products. You will work alongside experienced architects to evaluate new memory features, analyze architectural trade-offs, develop performance models, and explore solutions that improve memory performance, reliability, and efficiency for AI and high-performance computing workloads.

- Research and evaluate next-generation HBM architecture and microarchitecture features, including memory scheduling, refresh management, reliability features, thermal behavior, and memory controller interactions.

- Collaborate with architecture, design, memory controller, and cross-functional engineering teams to support feature definition, design reviews, specifications, and roadmap development.

Minimum Qualifications

- 0-2 years of relevant experience through internships, research, academic projects, publications, or coursework in computer architecture, memory systems, VLSI, semiconductor design, or related technical fields.
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Coursework or project experience in computer architecture, memory hierarchies, DRAM technologies, interconnects, or hardware system design.
- Programming experience with Python and at least one of the following: C++, SystemVerilog, or similar engineering languages.
- Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, standards documentation, datasheets, or hardware interface definitions.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
- Experience utilizing AI coding assistants and large language models (LLMs) such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar technologies as part of engineering workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with memory or system simulation environments such as Ramulator, DRAMSim, gem5, or related architectural modeling tools.
- Knowledge of HBM, DDR, LPDDR, GDDR, memory controller architectures, or memory subsystem design.
- Familiarity with memory reliability and availability concepts, including ECC, repair mechanisms, refresh algorithms, or RAS features.
- Experience with SystemVerilog, digital design, RTL development, or verification methodologies.
- Experience applying AI tools to software development, data analysis, technical research, document analysis, workflow automation, or agentic engineering workflows.
- Understanding of AI training, inference, accelerator architectures, and the role of HBM in large-scale AI systems.
- Previous internship, research, publication, or project experience related to memory systems, computer architecture, semiconductor design, or SoC development.

About Archaea

bp is committed to investing in lower carbon energy so we can meet our ambition to reach net zero by 2050. And while we’re still mostly in oil and gas today, bioenergy is one of our five transition growth engines and a key focus to help us support the global energy transition.

title: Software Engineer Data Platform
description:
Bij BeFrank bouwen we aan een modern dataplatform waarmee we data uit tientallen bronnen ontsluiten en omzetten naar producten die direct waarde leveren voor onze klanten en collega's. Daarvoor zoeken we geen traditionele data engineer. We zoeken een software engineer die het leuk vindt om complexe datavraagstukken op te lossen.

Je schrijft graag robuuste software die jarenlang mee kan, waarbij je data beschikbaar maakt voor analyses, rapportages en AI-toepassingen.Jij zorgt ervoor dat de oplossing robuust en betrouwbaar werkt, ongeacht de schaal van de data of het type bronsysteem dat wordt ontsloten.

Daarnaast denk je mee over de technische richting van het platform. Hoe richten we onze architectuur in? Hoe houden we oplossingen schaalbaar? Hoe borgen we kwaliteit en onderhoudbaarheid naarmate het landschap groeit?

Wat deze functie bijzonder maakt, is dat je werkt op het snijvlak van softwareontwikkeling en data. Je bouwt productiewaardige Python-applicaties en datapipelines, automatiseert processen, richt CI/CD in en zorgt dat kwaliteit vanaf het begin onderdeel is van het ontwerp.

Je krijgt daarbij veel ruimte om zelf verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en verbeteringen voor te stellen. In een relatief klein team heeft iedere engineer direct invloed op de keuzes die worden gemaakt.

Wat je concreet gaat doen:

-
Productiewaardige datapipelines schrijven in Python en PySpark volgens de medallion-architectuur (bronze, silver, gold) op Delta Lake.

-
Het ontsluiten van data uit verschillende bronsystemen: relationele databases, NoSQL databases, Blob/S3 storage, REST API's, SFTP servers etc.

-
Tests schrijven op meerdere niveaus: unit tests, integratietests en BDD-tests voor datatransformaties, en deze integreren in het CI/CD proces in Azure DevOps.

-
Datakwaliteit validaties ontwerpen en implementeren, zodat dataproblemen vroegtijdig worden gesignaleerd en afgevangen.

-
Nauw samenwerken met data- en businessanalisten aan datamodellen en dataproducten die businesswaarde leveren.

-
Zelfstandig technische oplossingen ontwerpen en weten te implementeren binnen de software/cloud architectuur van het dataplatform.

-
Actief bijdragen aan het kennisniveau binnen het engineering team, waarbij je geregeld nieuwe ideeën/tools presenteert en feedback geeft op code van je collega engineers.

Met wie je werkt
In het datateam, dat verder bestaat uit de architect, product owner, data scientists en twee andere engineers, ben jij een van de drie engineers. Je werkt met deze rollen nauw samen om het dataplatform naar het volgende niveau te tillen.Verder zijn er binnen BeFrank nog 5 andere IT teams waarmee je vaak in aanraking komt. Bij BeFrank I&T werken wij volgens de Agile Scrum methodiek.

Wat we zoeken

Wij zoeken iemand die zich herkent in softwareontwikkeling.

Je hebt ervaring met Python en bent gewend om te werken met versiebeheer, code reviews, testen en CI/CD. Je begrijpt hoe je software ontwerpt die ook over drie jaar nog goed te onderhouden is.

Heb je een achtergrond als backend developer, platform engineer, software consultant of AI engineer? Dan nodigen we je nadrukkelijk uit om te reageren.

Wat je meebrengt
Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau met relevante werkervaring als data engineer. Je schrijft productiewaardige Python-code — geen notebooks of low-code, maar software met een nette projectstructuur, herbruikbare componenten en foutafhandeling. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het inrichten van een robuust schaalbare dataplatform met PySpark en Delta Lake, inclusief ervaring met het implementeren van partitionering, schema-evolutie, time travel en merge/upsert-patronen op grootschalige datasets. Je bent bekend met de medallion-architectuur of vergelijkbare gelaagde dataplatformprincipes. Je hebt ervaring met het aansluiten van uiteenlopende bronsystemen met verschillende type koppelingen. Datakwaliteit is voor jou geen bijzaak: je hebt ervaring met het inrichten van validaties en het borgen van datakwaliteit in het proces. Het schrijven van geautomatiseerde tests en het inrichten van CI/CD-pipelines is voor jou geen onbekend terrein. Je bent een teamspeler die logische modellen en businessdefinities weet te vertalen naar een gedegen fysiek datamodel. Ervaring met de Azure-datastack (Synapse, Data Factory, Azure Functions) is een pre.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden die bij jou passen
Behalve uitdagend werk binnen een omgeving waar jouw initiatief op prijs wordt gesteld, bieden wij jou een uitstekend arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, dat bestaat uit:

-
Passend salaris o.b.v. 40 uur (Salarisschaal € 4.665 - € 6.665 afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring)

-
Vaste eindejaarsuitkering

-
Prestatiebonus

-
Internetvergoeding

-
NS Business Card, waarmee je ook privé vrij kan reizen, kilometervergoeding of een (elektrische) Swapfiets

-
29 vakantiedagen + 1 persoonlijke feestdag

-
Modern premievrij pensioen

-
Goede opleidingsmogelijkheden

-
Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid

-
Hybride werken vanuit ons duurzaam verbouwde kantoor in Amsterdam! (Bij BeFrank werken we allemaal minstens 50% op kantoor, maar 100% op kantoor mag natuurlijk ook.)

Over BeFrank
Wij zijn een moderne, online pensioenuitvoerder en bieden bedrijven een collectieve pensioenoplossing. Onze missie is om pensioen weer dichter bij de mens te brengen. Dat doen we door begrijpelijk te communiceren en alles eenvoudig te houden. En door zowel werkgevers als werknemers 24/7 inzicht te geven in hun pensioen via een slimme en duidelijke online omgeving.

Wij zijn B Corp! Sinds 2024 zijn we officieel een B Corp. Dat betekent dat we ondernemen met oog voor mens, maatschappij en milieu. We beleggen duurzaam, we doen vrijwilligerswerk en reizen zo bewust mogelijk. Ook ons kantoor is gebouwd met de toekomst in gedachten en is voor 80% circulair. Want pensioen gaat niet alleen over geld. Het gaat ook over de wereld waarin je straks leeft.

Onze cultuur. Onze cultuur kenmerkt zich door lef, innovatie en klantgericht denken. Omdat we een zelfstandig label zijn hebben we korte lijnen. We werken elke dag hard om het beste product te maken, met de beste service. En successen vieren we samen!

Iedereen hoort erbij bij BeFrank! Wij geloven in de kracht van een inclusieve werkomgeving, waarin je 100% jezelf kunt zijn. Daarom vinden we het belangrijk dat iedereen met een drive om de pensioenwereld te vernieuwen zich welkom voelt om bij ons te solliciteren.

Meer weten over werken bij BeFrank? Lees dan verder op onze website.

Word jij onze nieuwe collega?

Ben jij enthousiast over deze vacature en denk je dat je goed past in het team en bij BeFrank? Solliciteer dan direct via onderstaande button en upload je cv en een korte motivatie! Wij zijn erg benieuwd naar wie jij bent, wat jou beweegt en wat jij kunt bijdragen in deze functie bij BeFrank.

**Het proces bestaat uit twee gesprekken waaronder een case presentatie.

title: Specialist, Account Data Management & Governance

The role has a growth path toward broader ownership of account lifecycle processes and offshore workflow oversight as the function matures over 1–3 years.

Responsibilities

Data Quality & Exception Resolution

Manually investigate and resolve mismatched account data across systems, working directly with data owners to align fields and definitions.

Download and review data exceptions daily; and reach out to account owners to resolve breaks.

Account Onboarding & Data Setup

Submit, review and approve New Account Application (NAA) updates

Manage account openings at custodian portals.

-
Maintain Aladdin data through updates in ADAM and Blackrock Portfolio Toolkit.

Establish consistent entity records and account reference data across systems.

Define and supervise governance of critical data elements.

Add new Account Business Terms into Glossary+ to support enterprise data cataloging.

Add new rules to the Data Platform Portal, including rules that utilize lookup tables.

-
Review Data Warehouse discrepancies and drive resolution.

-
Perform ERISA and other regulatory flag controls data review.

Perform user access screening for account master data.

Technology Partnership & Continuous Improvement

Identify and project manage account data enhancements across key systems and stakeholders.

-
Submit stories to technology and attend grooming sessions to shape upcoming enhancements.

-
Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for submitted stories.

-
Submit stories for new Datactics rules to support automated exception detection.

-
Collaborate on cross-functional projects where account data is used.

Stakeholder Coordination & Reporting

-
Lead a weekly account data meeting with key stakeholders to review open items and exception trends.

-
Organize the Account Owners Quarterly Discussion/Update call, providing updates on progress against the roadmap.

-
Prepare and present quarterly update for Enterprise Data Governance (EDG) leadership.

-
Partner across front office (Sales, Portfolio Management) and control teams (Operations, Finance, Legal & Compliance, Technology), and offshore teams on account data initiatives.

Required Qualifications

-
Bachelor’s degree

-
5-8+ years of relevant experience

-
Experience with reference data, security master, or account master data.

-
Experience documenting and mapping business processes.

-
Project management and business analysis experience.

-
Strong data analysis, profiling, and discovery skills.

-
Ability to manage multiple concurrent work efforts independently.

-
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

-
Proficiency in MS Excel, Visio (or equivalent), and PowerPoint.

-
Comfort with hands-on manual data investigation and exception resolution.

Preferred

-
Hands-on experience with Aladdin, Datactics, and/or VantageIQ.

-
Data governance experience in financial services.

-
Fund launch or fund onboarding experience.

-
Investment operations background.

-
5+ years of asset management experience.

-
Experience with data cataloging tools (e.g., Collibra) or lookup-table-driven rules engines.

-
Exposure to offshore team coordination.

Location: New York City; hybrid with a minimum of three days per week in office.

As a Module Engineering PhD Intern, you will play a key role in developing and optimizing semiconductor manufacturing processes for a specific module. title: Project Manager Sr
description:
At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career.

ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future.

JOB SUMMARY

Manages projects in accordance with established project governance. Plans, directs and coordinates activities of assigned projects for designated IT or Business area, to ensure that goals and approved scope are accomplished within the prescribed time frame and funding parameters. Develops, manages and coordinates project plans of different degrees of complexity. Manages a detailed work breakdown, resource commitments, budget, risks, and communication for each phase of the project, as required by project governance. Partners with the project Business Owner and Technical Lead on project delivery strategy, providing focus on transparency and project controls.

JOB DUTIES

- Understands and applies principles, theories and concepts related to the profession and ERCOT's culture.
- Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action.
- Impact is generally limited to specific assignments or projects.
- May respond to inquiries and/or provide assistance and/or guidance to lower level workers.

ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES

- Leads multiple medium/high complexity projects simultaneously, maintaining deep engagement across all workstreams and resource pools, under supervision of PMO management.
- Partners with the project business owner, and technical lead to determine the delivery strategy, provide direction to the project team, and drive stakeholder awareness.
- Provides concise executive-level communication and recommendations to sponsors, steering committees, and senior leadership.
- Manages complex team dynamics, effectively facilitates conflict resolution, conducts negotiations, and achieves organizational objectives through strategic influence absent formal authority, with support from PMO management.
- Actively engages the project team to drive delivery by facilitating decisions, resolving blockers, identifying risks, issues, and mitigation plans, and maintaining momentum across workstreams, project team members, vendors, and stakeholders.
- Navigates a matrixed resource environment, negotiating resource commitments with resource and project managers across competing project priorities.
- Manages external dependencies across teams, systems, and delivery timelines to maintain schedule integrity and risk management.
- Identifies and manages cross-project and cross-program dependencies that may impact scope, schedule, cost, or business outcomes.
- Escalates issues appropriately and facilitate timely decision-making among stakeholders when priorities or requirements conflict.
- Conducts deep scope analysis to develop and maintain a detailed, accurate work breakdown structure throughout the project lifecycle.
- Maintains a current and accurate project plan at all times, reflecting real resource assignments, actual progress, and updated forecasts.
- Maintains reasonable variance between cost forecasts and actuals, with timely explanations for deviations.
- Coordinates vendor procurement, engagement, delivery and performance in alignment with project objectives, as applicable.
- Partners with business stakeholders to support organizational readiness, adoption planning, and implementation activities.
- Maintains timesheet compliance across the project team, including reviewing and approving or rejecting weekly time submissions.
- Utilizes existing and emerging technologies to drive efficient and effective project operations, including collaboration and productivity tools, AI, data analysis, and PPM tooling.
- Operates effectively within a highly regulated, audit-conscious environment, ensuring project documentation, compliance artifacts, and reporting meet organizational and regulatory standards.
- Supports PMO continuous improvement initiatives, as assigned.
- Supports PMO sponsored projects or other initiatives, as assigned.
- Fosters a project culture aligned with ERCOT’s core values.

EXPERIENCE

- Minimum 5 years related work experience managing projects, product or workstream delivery, in excess of degree requirements (Required)

- Experience as a project manager within a formal enterprise PMO, including structured phase-gate governance and tollgate approval processes and accountability for executive engagement.
- Experience managing medium/high complexity projects with cross-functional resource pools.
- Experience working within a matrixed organization, including resource negotiation and shared-service delivery models.
- Experience operating in a highly regulated, audit-conscious environment with formal documentation, compliance, and reporting requirements.
- Experience managing projects using traditional waterfall and hybrid methodologies within a structured phase-gate governance framework.

- Working experience at an ISO/RTO, ISO/RTO stakeholder, or Electric Utility environment (Preferred)
- Proficiency in a Project Management scheduling tool such as Microsoft Project, as well as practical experience using a project ticketing and workflow system such as JIRA. (Required)
- Proficiency in AI prompt design. (Preferred)
- Additional preferred experience depending upon the hiring team and project demands.

- Digital & ERP Projects -

- IT infrastructure projects, including data center refresh, compute and storage upgrades, network modernization, or fiber expansion
- Enterprise application implementations, migrations, or end-of-life system replacements
- Cybersecurity or compliance-driven initiatives, including security assessments, endpoint protection, or regulatory standard alignment
- Identity and access management (IAM) projects, including governance, provisioning, or access control implementations
- Enterprise data, AI, or toolchain modernization initiatives, including data governance, platform migrations, or developer tooling
- Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Treasury, and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) projects

- PMP Project Management Professional (Preferred)

description:

What we offer:

At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

Group Summary:

Magna New Mobility is a business unit inside Magna International leveraging Magna’s technology building blocks, developing new capabilities, and entering new markets and use cases. Our products include advanced solutions for urban markets, industrial intralogistics, commercial and autonomous vehicles.

Magna New Mobility is also creating advanced software solutions that integrate with next-generation hardware. Our software is a core driver - turning our hardware into smart, integrated platforms for partners eager to advance the mobility sector.

Magna's New Mobility group is not just about building individual technologies; we aim to create integrated solutions that address the complex challenges of moving people efficiently and cost effectively in the 21st century. Join us in advancing and shaping the future of mobility.

Job Responsibilities:

This role is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, deploying, and validating robotics software for Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) and Fleet Management Systems. The primary responsibilities include developing robot control, navigation, traffic management, fleet coordination, and system integration software while ensuring system reliability, scalability, and real-time performance.

The role also includes validating and maintaining existing AMR systems, supporting factory deployments, performing robot mapping and site commissioning, troubleshooting software issues, and collaborating with internal teams, suppliers, and customers to deliver robust industrial robotics solutions. Domestic and international travel is required to support customer deployments, system integration, commissioning, and onsite debugging activities.

What you will be doing in this role:

- Develop software for robot navigation, localization, path planning, robot control, traffic management, fleet coordination, and mission execution.
- Design and optimize algorithms for multi-robot coordination, mission scheduling, route optimization, collision avoidance, and autonomous robot operation.
- Develop modular software components and optimize communication and data flow between robotics software modules.
- Integrate robotics software with Fleet Management Systems (FMS), PLCs, industrial communication protocols, and third-party systems.
- Develop internal software tools for robot configuration, deployment, monitoring, diagnostics, testing, and debugging.
- Validate robotics software through simulation, laboratory testing, and production environments, while tracking, analyzing, and resolving software issues.
- Perform robot mapping, localization tuning, system commissioning, and onsite deployment at customer manufacturing facilities.
- Support existing AMR systems by investigating software issues, performing root cause analysis, implementing fixes, and improving system stability and performance.
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, suppliers, and customers to support product development, factory deployment, and continuous system improvements.

What you should bring to this role:

- Master's or higher degree in Engineering including but not limited to: Mechanical, Electrical, Computer Science, Aerospace, and Robotics Automotive OEM or Tier-1 experience OR combination of Bachelors Degree and applicable experience required.
- Experience with ROS2 and NVIDIA required.
- Experience developing, integrating, validating, deploying, and debugging robotics software in production and customer environments.
- Hands-on experience with Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), robotics platforms, industrial automation systems, sensors, actuators, and communication networks.
- Experience performing robot deployment, mapping, commissioning, system validation, and onsite customer support.
- Experience investigating software issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions to improve system performance and reliability.
- Strong understanding of robotics algorithms including traffic management, fleet coordination, path planning, navigation, localization, and obstacle avoidance required.
- Strong C/C++, Python programming skills required.
- Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as MQTT, DDS, TCP/IP, Ethernet, CAN, REST API, and VDA5050 required.
- Ability to travel internationally to support business.

title: Senior Embedded Software Test Engineer
description:
Career-defining. Life-changing.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:

We are looking for a systematic, detail-orientated, and proactive Embedded Software Test Engineer who has an interest in medical devices and in trying to break them! You would design and execute tests in support of our Class II cardiac monitoring devices and their supporting software infrastructure. In this role, you will act as an advocate for the quality of our software, both from the perspective of our patients and our internal customers, working primarily with firmware written in C and with C#/.NET windows desktop applications.

The position is located in Cypress, CA, and the role is hybrid, requiring you to be in the office as needed to use hardware and electrical lab equipment.

What You Will Be Doing

- Perform manual system-level, functional, and acceptance testing on embedded systems software (C) and supporting desktop software applications (C#/.NET).
- Collaborate with members of R&D and Manufacturing, among other teams, to define and implement testing strategies.
- Develop written verification test protocols, then subsequently document and report test results to both functional and customer requirements - in a manner consistent with regulatory and internal standards.
- Review requirements and design documentation to ensure technical accuracy as well as testability; act as a quality advocate throughout the development process.
- Analyze and test field failures to establish repeatability before working with the development team to address the root cause, and verify the correction before release.

Required Experience

- At least 5 years of software quality or embedded software test experience.
- At least 3-4 years of experience in testing desktop tools and or testing embedded systems/hardware.
- Experience with electronic test equipment (power supplies, DMMs, oscilloscopes, etc) and ability to troubleshoot electrical and firmware issues on circuits/hardware.
- Very good understanding of QA principles and processes. Particularly a familiarity with the software QA process in the medical device industry or other regulated environment (e.g., FAA, SEC, DoD, Title 21 CFR part 11), and the related verification, validation, and documentation requirements.
- Excellent analytical and problem solving skills, finding creative solutions as well as enjoying investigative and troubleshooting processes.
- Self-motivated with ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in cross-functional teams, potentially leading testing efforts for a given project.
- Effective written communication skills in presentation of methods and observations.

Ways to Stand Out

- Proficiency in Linux/Unix environment.
- Work experience in a firmware or software development role.
- Programming experience in one or more of the following languages: Python, C/C++, .NET/C#, MYSQL
- Understanding of Test-Driven Development and related use of unit testing approaches and tools (e.g., JUnit).
